distinct_pools_basis: union of forged IPs per region, not per-target samples
method: the censor as sensor — benign stateless UDP DNS probes provoke the GFW's own injectors to answer; we fingerprint the fleet from the forgeries. Transport this round: direct injection over dark IPs + open-resolver fallback. Direct receive windows overlap; outbound sends remain rate-capped. Injector count is a FLOOR, not a census: each injector answers a given query at most once, so a silent injector is undercounted.

provenance.caveat: single-vantage round: observed censorship varies with network path, so cross-region comparisons from one prober are not identifiable (cf. arXiv:2406.19304).
provenance.flow_id_policy: ephemeral source port per query (paths not pinned)

scope: apparatus-layer tomography of the Great Firewall's DNS-injector fleet: forged-IP pools, a floor on parallel injector responses, and operational events, measured from outside China
title: GFW injector fleet
